en: A color postcard showing a central square in a historic European city. The view looks over an iron balcony toward a broad plaza with mid‑20th‑century cars, a baroque plague column or memorial in the middle, and ornate multi‑story buildings around the square. A prominent tall clock‑towered building and other historic facades line the left and center. The reverse side has printed and handwritten Hungarian text, a Hungarian stamp, and a PÉCS postmark.
